h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Giridih

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Giridih

items.pText: Giridih is a district town on the Chota Nagpur plateau, and its district includes Parasnath hill, one of the most important Jain pilgrimage sites. Schools, colonies and the dharamshalas along the pilgrimage route all have use for a well-planned play area. FunPlay Systems makes every piece at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,480 km away, and sends it to Jharkhand by road.

Buyers far from our factory often want to know what happens if something goes wrong after installation. That is a fair question, and the answer lies in our warranty and after-sales support, which we explain before you order. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India carries out the installation, using the self-standing or grouting method suited to your ground. You receive the maintenance notes at the same time.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

items: Galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope: 3 years.
Springs, bearings and spare parts: 1 year.

c: The warranty covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions. Keep the maintenance notes we share, check bolts and moving parts regularly, and call our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 if anything looks wrong. On the plateau, monsoon rain and summer heat both test fixings, so a check after each season helps.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,480 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: How long is the warranty on playground equipment?
items.a: Our frames, moulded parts, laminates and play ropes carry 3 years against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.
Yes. Equipment is made in Vasai and sent to Giridih by road. Our installation team or a dealer then installs it according to the approved layout drawing. Send us photos of the site to begin.

items.q: Can a dharamshala or trust order playground equipment?
items.a: Yes. Any trust, school or society can order from us. Share the space available and the age group of the children, and we will suggest equipment and a layout.
